purpose: Teach: 住友/トルシエ/ディープインパクト/ホリデー/シューティング/師範/ラヴ/ボクサー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが住友財閥のお話されたわ
lines.en: When you were young, your father used to talk about the Sumitomo zaibatsu, didn't he...
lines.style: Soft, reaching back into old memory. Gentle questioning tone, as if checking if she remembers too. Slow, unhurried. Slight wonder threaded through the wistfulness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、トルシエジャパンのワールドカップを観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you remember watching the Troussier Japan team at the World Cup, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, playful correction. A gentle redirect, like she's lovingly steering him toward shared joy instead of dwelling. Light, almost teasing affection in the lilt.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがディープインパクトの引退レースを観られた
lines.en: When you were young, your father went to see Deep Impact's retirement race...
lines.style: Quieter this time, more internal. Testing the memory, not asking for confirmation. Gentle fadeout, as if the detail itself is what matters, not her answer.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ホリデーシーズンを家族で過ごされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you remember spending the holiday season with the family, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Tender insistence. She's gently claiming these moments back from him. Soft but steady, like she's reminding him what actually mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがシューティングクラブに通われた
lines.en: When you were young, your father used to go to the shooting club...
lines.style: Drifting deeper into memory now. Voice thinner, more searching. Each word placed carefully, like he's afraid of losing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、剣道の師範をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were a kendo master yourself, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright affection underneath. She's not asking—she's remembering aloud for both of them. Knowing, slightly mischievous, anchoring him to his own dignity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがロマンチックなラヴレターを下さった
lines.en: When you were young, your father wrote you such romantic love letters...
lines.style: Very soft now. Almost vulnerable. The memory catches in his voice. Pause before the last phrase, as if the tenderness is almost too much to speak.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃ボクサーに憧れたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you dreamed of becoming a boxer, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, intimate closeness. She's seeing him—the young man he was. Soft but affirming, like she's holding his youth gently for him now.
